title: Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning for Sample Efficient Experimentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-driving laboratories must learn to control a process from tens to hundreds of expensive experiments, too few for deep reinforcement learning (RL). We learn the Q-function directly with a Gaussian process (GP), which avoids learning the dynamics, and show that the GP posterior supplies the learning rate of Q-learning. If each Bellman target is treated as a noisy measurement of the Q-function, the learning rate that minimises the mean squared error is the Kalman gain, and applying it to every observed transition is equivalent to GP regression. Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning (HGPQ) sets the noise variance of each target with a heteroscedastic GP, which learns how unreliable the targets are across the states and inputs. translated_title: 面向样本高效实验的异方差高斯过程Q学习
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶实验室必须从数十到数百个昂贵实验中学习控制一个过程，这样的样本量对深度强化学习（RL）而言太少了。我们直接用高斯过程（GP）学习Q函数，从而避免了学习系统动力学，并证明高斯过程后验本身就提供了Q学习的学习率。如果将每个贝尔曼目标视为对Q函数的一次含噪测量，那么使均方误差最小的学习率就是卡尔曼增益，而将其应用于每一个观测到的状态转移则等价于高斯过程回归。异方差高斯过程Q学习（HGPQ）利用异方差高斯过程为每个目标设定噪声方差，学习目标值在不同状态和输入下有多不可靠。这样，来自嘈杂运行条件或值函数梯度较大区域的目标，对估计值的更新幅度会小于来自低噪声区域的目标，因此HGPQ能够在数据可靠的地方快速学习。
tldr: 提出异方差高斯过程Q学习（HGPQ），直接用高斯过程学习Q函数、将贝尔曼目标视为含噪测量，并借助异方差高斯过程自适应调整每个目标的学习率（即卡尔曼增益），从而在自动驾驶实验室等昂贵实验场景中实现样本高效的过程控制学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning (HGPQ), which learns the Q-function directly with a GP by treating Bellman targets as noisy measurements and uses a heteroscedastic GP to adapt the learning rate (Kalman gain) for each target, enabling sample-efficient process control in expensive experimentation settings such as self-driving laboratories.
